text_block_list.text: It's the last day of summer camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ever since her heat stroke, Нарита Брайан
has been
on an adjusted training
regimen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Back to normal.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me. You should focus
on
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
When we get back to the academy, I
want to train
for the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Is there anything else you'd like to do?

text_block_list.text: ...No. That's all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We don't have much time until the
Kikuka Sho.
We have to focus on what
really needs doing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: President!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I'll have a talk with the director
and URA
folks as soon as I get back.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I'm very sorry to make you do this...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. I've already run the
race I came
here to run. I've got more
time to spare than
anyone.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Looks like it'll have to wait even longer...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Silent, she clenches her fist tightly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If only she could have run against
Симболи Рудольф
when she had the
chance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If only she'd stayed in good enough
condition to
run against Symboli
Rudolf...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Is there anyone left?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you... I figured Brian would have
already
boarded the bus.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Did something happen?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
When she fully recovers, I'd like you to run with
her.

text_block_list.text:
...The results of competition strongly
affect us for
better and for worse.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we must choose both the
time and the
opponent carefully—for
both our sakes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Were it still summer, it would've been
motivating
for her. But fall is an
important season for the two
of you, is it
not?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: If she were to lose at a time like this...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: ...I'm fully aware of what I'm asking.

text_block_list.text: ...I'll give it some thought.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
